item.title: NBA: Minnesota Timberwolves ML -500 at BetRivers (Low, +6.7 pts)
item.description:

Moneyline: Minnesota Timberwolves ML at -500 (BetRivers). Our probability 90.1% from game data, the price implies 83.3%, edge +6.7 pts, EV +8.1% per unit. Confidence: Lean.

Our probability is 90.1%, from the game data: this season's results and margins, recent form, rest, the injury report and home edge (projected margin +16.2 for the home side). BetRivers offers -500, which implies only 83.3%. Its bar is 6.4 points: the model's own margin of error on this side, with 9 games behind the thinner team (±4.58 points on the margin). It clears it by 0.4. Not graded against other books' prices; for reference the market makes it 82.0%.

What supports it:

  • Minnesota Timberwolves rate +6.3 a game over 10 (7-3), Utah Jazz -8.1 over 9 (1-8); last season +3.4 and -8.4 a game.
  • Home edge +1.9 for Minnesota Timberwolves.
  • Utah Jazz without Jaren Jackson Jr. (F) (+1.8).
  • Utah Jazz have Lauri Markkanen (F) listed day-to-day or questionable.
  • Projected margin +16.2 for Minnesota Timberwolves.

What could go wrong:
